claims.statement: A defensible individualized nutrition assessment should not be reduced to the currently visible anthropometric and blood-pressure observations; relevant assessment may require additional food/nutrition, biochemical/medical-test, physical-finding, and client-history information depending on the decision.
claims.boundary: Does not assert that every listed domain is mandatory for every decision.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: Professional-process evidence supports multi-domain assessment and missing-information acquisition. D2 completion changes only the case-view wording from systolic-only BP to BP observations; the underlying epistemic state remains PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.

claims.statement: Requesting additional relevant information is itself a scientifically legitimate nutrition-assessment action when available data are insufficient for the downstream nutrition decision.
claims.boundary: Does not determine which specific missing item is mandatory in EP-NHANES-L-0001.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: The professional assessment source directly supports acquiring additional relevant information as part of assessment.

claims.statement: The visible systolic and diastolic blood-pressure measurements and their derived means must not be converted by this research case into a confirmed hypertension diagnosis or into a diagnosis-dependent individualized nutrition prescription without appropriate measurement and clinical context.
claims.boundary: The observed systolic and diastolic values may be numerically compared with published BP categories, but diagnostic confirmation remains outside the authorized inference.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: Current corrected guideline and measurement guidance continue to support the no-diagnosis-from-snapshot boundary after DBP restoration; scope is refreshed from systolic-only to the complete visible BP tuple.

claims.statement: The completed D2 view has a derived mean blood pressure of approximately 132.7/96.0 mmHg. Under the 2025 AHA/ACC category framework, the systolic component lies in the stage-1 range while the diastolic component meets the stage-2 threshold; because the framework uses an OR criterion, the overall numerical category mapping is stage 2. This numerical category mapping is not equivalent to a confirmed hypertension diagnosis.
claims.boundary: Numerical category mapping only. It does not establish diagnosis, treatment indication, or individualized nutrition prescription.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: Both BP means are deterministically reproducible. The current category framework uses SBP OR DBP thresholds, so DBP 96 mmHg changes the complete-view numerical mapping to stage 2 while the no-diagnosis boundary remains unchanged.
claims.prior_case_mapping_status: SUPERSEDED: systolic-only stage-1 mapping from ScientificClaim_Set_v0.2 is incomplete under the completed D2 view.

claims.statement: A USPSTF healthy-diet/physical-activity behavioral-counseling recommendation for increased CVD risk should only be projected onto this case after the relevant risk-factor status is established; the current sparse view does not establish the full applicability conditions.
claims.boundary: The source supports general benefits of healthy behavior but does not authorize case-specific counseling eligibility without risk assessment.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: The USPSTF recommendation explicitly conditions applicability on cardiovascular risk-factor context; the authorized case view does not establish the complete condition set.

claims.statement: General Dietary Guidelines for Americans can supply broad healthy-pattern context but cannot, by themselves, establish that the current information is sufficient for an individualized nutrition recommendation.
claims.boundary: General-population advice and individualized reference construction are distinct objects.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: The Dietary Guidelines source establishes general-population guidance, while the stronger statement that it cannot alone establish individualized-reference sufficiency additionally depends on Foundation/NDF object-boundary rules.

claims.statement: The observed BMI of 27 kg/m^2 falls in the USPSTF overweight range (25-29.9), not the BMI >=30 population targeted by the USPSTF B recommendation for intensive multicomponent behavioral weight-loss intervention.
claims.boundary: This does not imply that weight management is unnecessary or that no other nutrition intervention could be appropriate.
claims.epistemic_state_rationale: Observed/recalculated BMI is reproducible and the recommendation population threshold is directly stated by the source.

prohibited_claims: A specific diet is indicated now.
Every nutrition-assessment domain is mandatory before any individualized recommendation.
invariant: D2 observation completion may revise case-specific mapping without retroactively falsifying the earlier authorized-view reconstruction; historical claim versions remain preserved.
